profile.shortIntro: Fifth-year medical student at Ain Shams University with clinical training at El-Demerdash Hospital across internal medicine, chest medicine, respiratory intensive care, obstetrics and gynecology, neurology, and ENT/head and neck surgery.
about: I am a fifth-year medical student at Ain Shams University with clinical training experience at El-Demerdash Hospital in a range of medical and surgical specialties.

My experience includes patient history taking, vital signs assessment, respiratory intensive care and chest medicine exposure, and supervised clinical participation around cesarean sections, vaginal deliveries, and ENT/head and neck surgical cases, including maxillary carcinoma cases and surgical complications.

Outside the hospital, I have volunteered with Bedaya Medical Caravan and contributed to Fekra Society's FCMC medical innovation initiative. I value continuous learning, teamwork, communication, and patient-centered care.

highlights: Undertook clinical training in Internal Medicine, with exposure to the Respiratory Intensive Care Unit (RICU) and Chest Department.
